paite: TOUPA koute TOUPA aw, leitung tengteng ah na minhoih hi na tel e! Na thupina thu van tungte ah na koih a.
heading: Gitith A Sak Ding. David La. / Pathian Thupina Leh Mihing Zahtakhuaina
english: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

paite: Melma leh phulami daihsakna ding in, hon doute ziak in naungek leh nawi ne laite kam a pawt in hatna na hihkip hi.
english: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

paite: Na van, na khutsuakte, kha leh aksi na sehte, ka ngaihtuah chiang in,
english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

paite: Mihing bang ahia, huchi tel a na limsak? Mihing tapa leng bang ahia, huchi tel a na veh? ka chi hi.
english: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

paite: Amah zaw angelte sang a nuaizaw phet in na bawl a, thupina leh pahtawina na khusak hi.
english: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

paite: Na khutsuak tungte ah thu na neisak a; akhenuai ah bangpeuh na koih a.
english: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

paite: Belam leh bawng tengteng toh, ahi, gamsate toh leng;
english: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

paite: Tung a leng vasa leh tuipi ngasate, tuipi a lampi tawn peuhmahte toh.
english: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

paite: TOUPA kou TOUPA aw, leitung tengteng ah na minhoih hi na tel e!
english: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
